_comment: Coverage-threshold FLOOR per app. check-coverage-ratchet.ts fails if any app's configured coverageThreshold drops below these. Raising is free; LOWERING requires editing this baseline in the same PR — turning the historically-silent 'fix(ci): lower coverage thresholds' drift into an explicit, reviewable change. To lock a higher floor after adding tests, bump both the config and this file.
_web_note: 2026-08-02: branches 10→9 and functions 10→7. This is NOT the drift this file exists to block. apps/web/vitest.config.ts stopped excluding src/app/**/page.tsx + layout.tsx, adding ~4.5k always-untested statements to the denominator; the same test suite therefore measures lower. The old 10/10/10/10 was also never enforced — CI ran `pnpm --filter web test` (= plain `vitest run`, no --coverage), so no web threshold had been checked in CI at all. Both gaps closed in the same change: CI now runs coverage for web and mobile. Floors are set just under the measured 10.24/9.54/7.43/10.41.
